question: Who was the eldest of four sons of Babur?
solution:
correct answer is __**Humayun.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Humayun** was the **eldest son of Babur** and ascended the throne in 1530 AD.
 
• His birth name was** Nasir al-Din Muhammad**.
 
• **Kamran, Hindal and Askari** were brothers of Humayun.
 
• **Abu'l-Nasir Muhammad **better known by "Hindal"
 
 
• He was a Mughal prince and the **youngest son of Emperor Babur.**
 
• The founder of the Mughal Empire and the** first Mughal emperor.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Battle of Chausa (1539 AD)** :

 
 
• It was fought between **Sher Shah and Humayun’s** **army** and Humayun was defeated.
 
 
 
• **Battle of Kannauj (Bilgrama) (1540 AD). **
 
 
• **Humayun** was again **defeated by Sher Shah **
 
 
 
• **Akbar** was the** **son of Humayun**.**
 
 
• **​**The name Akbar literally means** ''the great''.**
 
• He was the Mughal emperor who was known for his **tolerance, achievements, and socio-political reforms**.
 
• He conquered the N**orthern region of India first**.
 
 
 
• Shah Jahan was the son of Jahangir.
 
• **Changez Khan** was the **founder of the Mongol Empire**.
